source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Each time an enemy unit no more than 6" from the bearer, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, fails a Battle-shock test, its controlling player picks 1 of its models to be **destroyed**.

Once per battle, you can make that D3 of its models instead, still picked by that player. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.trigger: an enemy unit no more than 6" from the bearer fails a Battle-shock test

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the 1st Company Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
